lip_liner_pairing.pairing_rule: Prefer same-family or one-step-deeper liner. Do not force a visibly darker liner unless the user asks for a sculpted/ombre look.

neutral_outfits.strategy: Nearly all lip families work; choose intensity from occasion.

warm_earth_outfits.strategy: Warm earthy lip families create tonal harmony; berry/plum can be used for contrast.

green_emerald_outfits.strategy: Terracotta/brick gives warm contrast; berry/plum gives richer contrast.

blue_navy_teal_outfits.strategy: Cool rose/berry/plum coordinates; coral/brick can provide warm contrast.

pink_red_burgundy_outfits.strategy: Use nude for balance or same-family rose/berry for coordinated color.

purple_plum_outfits.strategy: Cool mauve/plum families coordinate; neutral nude keeps the eye/outfit dominant.

guardrails: Undertone and complexion depth are ranking signals, not hard eligibility gates.
Do not claim a shade is universally flattering.
Do not turn visual-estimate HEX into a lab-validated or manufacturer-confirmed colour claim.
Do not surface mock INCI, wear, transfer, safety or regulatory data as factual customer claims.
For clear oil/plumper variants, hex remains null and is_clear is true.

products.name: Petal Velvet Lip Color

description.short: A wearable lip-colour formula designed for comfortable everyday colour.
description.full: Petal Velvet Lip Color is a wearable lip-colour formula designed for comfortable everyday colour. It is positioned to add lip colour. It also supports comfortable everyday makeup. Final performance claims should be aligned with the validated production formula and testing.
